Render Pipeline Documents and Reports

Source: R/render.R
render.Rd

Dispatches Quarto or R Markdown compilation across single documents, directories, or computational pipeline graphs, with support for staleness detection, range filtering, cache invalidation, error recovery, run manifests, and renv guards.

Usage

render(
  path,
  formats = getOption("pipeline.default_formats", c("pdf", "docx")),
  pattern = "\\.(qmd|Rmd|rmd)$",
  engine = c("auto", "quarto", "rmarkdown"),
  workers = 1,
  only_stale = TRUE,
  from = NULL,
  to = NULL,
  dry_run = FALSE,
  cache = c("keep", "refresh", "stale"),
  on_error = c("continue", "stop"),
  resume = NULL,
  manifest = TRUE,
  renv_guard = TRUE,
  seed = NULL,
  skip_downstream = TRUE,
  rerun = c("none", "full"),
  stale_by = c("mtime", "hash"),
  hash_file = NULL,
  ...
)

render_me(
  path,
  formats = getOption("pipeline.default_formats", c("pdf", "docx")),
  pattern = "\\.(qmd|Rmd|rmd)$",
  engine = c("auto", "quarto", "rmarkdown"),
  workers = 1,
  only_stale = TRUE,
  from = NULL,
  to = NULL,
  dry_run = FALSE,
  cache = c("keep", "refresh", "stale"),
  on_error = c("continue", "stop"),
  resume = NULL,
  manifest = TRUE,
  renv_guard = TRUE,
  seed = NULL,
  skip_downstream = TRUE,
  rerun = c("none", "full"),
  stale_by = c("mtime", "hash"),
  hash_file = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

path

A file path (character), directory, list of files, or list of pipeline objects (`FilePath`, `FileUses`, `FileOutputs`).

formats

Character vector of output formats (e.g. `c("pdf", "docx", "html")`).

pattern

File pattern regex matching documents to render.

engine

Rendering engine: `"auto"` (default), `"quarto"`, or `"rmarkdown"`.

workers

Number of parallel workers for concurrent rendering via `future`/`furrr`. Defaults to `1` (sequential). Set to `> 1` to initialize multisession workers, or `NULL` to use an existing `future::plan()` without altering it.

only_stale

Logical. When `TRUE` (default), only out-of-date documents are rendered. When `FALSE`, performs a full graph rerun.

from

Optional starting node name or index in the topological plan.

to

Optional ending node name or index in the topological plan.

dry_run

Logical. When `TRUE`, prints the ordered render plan without executing.

cache

Cache handling: `"keep"` (default), `"refresh"` (wipes `_cache` and `_files`), or `"stale"`.

on_error

Behavior upon error: `"continue"` (default) or `"stop"`.

resume

Optional data frame of previous render results to resume from.

manifest

Logical. When TRUE (default), writes a render_manifest.json beside rendered outputs containing TempleCBE version, git commit hash, package versions, RNG seed, future plan, and per-document wall time.

renv_guard

Logical. When TRUE (default), verifies that renv is active if an renv.lock exists, and warns of any package version discrepancies.

seed

Optional integer seed for reproducible document execution.

skip_downstream

Logical (default `TRUE`). Skip downstream targets when an upstream target fails.

rerun

One of `"none"` (default) or `"full"` (forces `only_stale = FALSE` and `cache = "refresh"`).

stale_by

Staleness strategy: `"mtime"` (default; compares file modification times) or `"hash"` (compares SHA-256 content hashes of declared inputs and outputs stored in `pipeline_hashes.json`).

hash_file

Optional path to `pipeline_hashes.json` when `stale_by = "hash"`.

...

Additional arguments passed to rendering engines.

Value

A data frame of rendered files, output formats, durations, and status.
